newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GM Holden says recalls 120,000 cars.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GM Holden says recalls 120,000 cars.

text.p: General Motors Corp's Australian unit, General Motors-Holden's Automotive Corp, said on Friday it would issue a recall notice for 120,000 of its Commodore model passenger vehicles after detecting a potential transmission problem.
Towing of Holden's VR and VS Commodores outside company recommended guidelines might cause the fluid in the automatic transmission to deteriorate and overheat, the company said in a statement.
"Under these circumstances, overheated transmission fluid may be vented onto hot engine parts, and ignite," it said.
Holden said there had been 20 cases of the fluid igniting due to the transmission problem.
The company said the remedy was simple and would take less than 20 minutes to implement.
Holden spokesman John Morrison declined to comment on how much the recall would cost but said it would have a negative impact on the company's bottom line.
